project.title: Agriculture Canada - Cloud Centre of Expertise / Cloud Operations

role_overview.summary: Christian served as AWS Cloud DevOps Architect, part-time, at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) from January 2021 to September 2023, supporting the Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE) in its mandate to provide a secure, scalable, and governed public cloud environment for departmental business users and analytics workloads. Working within that mandate on AWS, his engagement spanned two tracks: the Cloud Operations platform team, which was responsible for AAFC's managed AWS Landing Zone (a multi-account AWS foundation with governance layers) and the full Authority to Operate (ATO) effort, and the Analytics team, which developed cloud-native applications for departmental data analysis. On the platform track, he built compliance tooling aligned to Government of Canada (GoC) Information Technology Security Guidance (ITSG) controls, created bespoke monitoring in AWS Security Hub for ITSG-33 (the GoC IT security risk management framework), and integrated Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) single sign-on (SSO) federation. On the analytics track, he built a cloud-native AWS analytics stack and a DevSecOps pipeline with automated code and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security scanning. The platform work contributed to the AAFC Enterprise Tenant receiving full ATO approval, allowing workloads in the tenant to inherit the ATO controls, while the analytics work gave the Analytics team continuous, auditable cloud delivery.

challenge.summary: AAFC's CCoE needed to provide internal business users and analytics teams with a secure, scalable managed public cloud environment, with the AWS environment using standard AWS Landing Zone foundations and layers of IaC governance resources to meet both operational and security requirements. Under a part-time architecture engagement spanning two concurrent teams, the work needed to meet applicable GoC ITSG controls and Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) cloud guardrails, supply evidence for the AAFC Enterprise Tenant's ATO, and ensure analytics releases had both application code and IaC scanned. Without automated compliance checks, audits would take weeks or months of manual console ("click-ops") labour, and without auto-remediation, remediation gaps would last days to weeks.

solution.summary: Delivered cloud governance, compliance automation, and DevSecOps engineering across two departmental workstreams:
deliverables: Cloud Centre of Expertise / Cloud Operations

outcomes: Full ATO approval achieved for the AAFC Enterprise Tenant against GoC ITSG controls, where workloads inherit the ATO controls

Automated compliance checks and auto-remediation were put in place; without automated checks, manual console audits would take weeks or months, and without auto-remediation, remediation gaps would last days to weeks. Bespoke AWS Security Hub monitoring for GoC ITSG controls covered the entire AWS Organization, and Azure AD SSO federation was implemented for the Landing Zone.
Cloud-native AWS analytics platform delivered for departmental data analysis workloads, with continuous delivery and an auditable deployment history
Application code and IaC security scanning automated by the DevSecOps pipeline for analytics releases, alongside security and governance reporting produced by Christian on both
